name: Runway
description: Cash, burn and runway by program, with what-if scenarios. One live forecast from spend and cash-in lines, people and milestones; a locked budget per year; monthly close with variance and frozen snapshots; 12 currencies with monthly rates. Values are edited where they are shown and saved at once. Claude and ChatGPT can run every action through app commands.
whenToUse: A small biotech (roughly 10–50 people) needs cash runway, burn, budget versus actual and what-ifs by program without an ERP: how long the cash lasts, whether it reaches the next milestone, when to start raising, and a clean monthly picture for the board.
whenNotToUse: General ledger or bookkeeping, payroll, three-statement reporting, revenue/AR/AP or debt modelling, consolidation, 13-week cash, tax-credit calculation, cap table or dilution, bank or accounting connectors, and any patient-level data.

heading.description: The name the app keeps when an assistant saves a layout change (layout.save). The app draws no heading of its own; the platform header shows the app's name.

tableMap.description: JSON object keyed by stable role key: runway.settings, runway.plan_lines, runway.positions, runway.actuals, runway.month_closes, runway.budgets, runway.scenarios, runway.fx_rates; core contract v1 roles programs, organizations, agreements; integrations programs.plan_items (Runway's milestone list, or the Programs app's key milestones once linked), croselection.awards, contracts.obligations and fundraise.tranches. Each value is {typeId:<authorized table UUID>, fields:{<logical key>:<real field key>}, writableFields:[<logical keys>], extraFields?:[{key,label,kind,options?}], writableExtra?:[<keys>]}. extraFields are bound fields added by a reviewed schema change; they appear in forms and Details and are never used in calculations. 2.0/2.1 role keys runway.milestones and runway.scenario_changes are still read.

pageSize.description: Rows per page in lists, 10–50; the template clamps the value.

layoutProfile.description: JSON presentation profile (screen order and visibility, column and form-field order, hidden optional fields, labels, defaults), written only by a layout change an assistant prepares (layout.save) and a person approves.

readOnly.description: When true, the app saves nothing, even for people who may edit.

instructions:
Runway 3.0.0 is a frontend-js app on the v2 contract and the kit (life.cash-runway). It replaces 2.2.1 with the same installer schema, role keys, calculation engine, app commands and recommended automations; an owner can upgrade a 2.2.0 or 2.2.1 copy (upgradeFrom) and keep its records.

1. Discover and pin. Read read_app_template_guidance (guide, then reference when extending) to the last nextOffset, read_app_design, list_app_templates and read_app_template for life.cash-runway. Pin this exact version and digest and keep one requestKey.
2. Install. Before installing, call list_archived_items (kind apps, this templateId) and offer to restore an archived Runway first. The installation popup connects existing programs, organizations and agreements tables (core.v1; reuse, never copy) and offers the recommended automations. Only the person confirms it. Never seed demo data.
3. Screens. Overview (runway sentence, the numbers that matter, Needs attention, cash curve, burn, why runway changed, cash at milestones), Cash flow, Plan (spend and cash-in lines, milestones, budgets, from other sources), People (list or board), Scenarios, Monthly close (starting point, months, variance, snapshots, actual records), Exchange rates, Programs, Organizations, and Settings for owners of the app only (reporting currency, target, trailing window, reserve, loaded cost, categories). A person edits values where they are shown and they save at once; a side panel creates records or edits many fields; Delete archives the record and offers Undo.
4. Control the app through its commands. list_app_commands returns every action a person can take; run_app_command runs it. Read commands (summary.read, cashflow.read, cashflow.drill, export.csv, scenario.evaluate, scenario.compare, variance.read, bridge.read, sources.read, schema.describe) return Runway's own results; never compute runway, burn or cash yourself. Write commands save directly (the result lists what was saved) when your Data level is Edit, with the same checks as a click; with View only they are refused. Tell the user what you saved. layout.save returns a layout change for the person to approve.
5. First runway. Ask for the bank balance and its month-end date, the reporting currency, programs and next milestones, the main spend lines and expected financing. Then settings.save, program.save, line.save, position.save, milestone.save and fx.save (rates for every non-reporting currency). Runway settings beyond the opening balance and its date can be changed only by owners of the app.
6. Monthly close. From a P&L or bank statement the user shares, map lines to categories, ask when a line is ambiguous, confirm the figures with the user, then month.close with the closing balance, actuals by category and commentary. The app computes and freezes the snapshot; you never write metrics.
7. What-ifs. Translate plain language into changes (shift_program, scale_program, stop_program, add_position, remove_position, move_cash_in, resize_cash_in, fx_shift, add_line, stop_line, shift_line, scale_line, scale_category, shift_position, change_salary) and run scenario.evaluate to report the app's figures. Save only when asked: scenario.save with status draft leaves it for the user to open, status saved makes it adoptable; scenario.adopt only on an explicit request.
8. Customize. Screens, columns and form fields (order, hidden optional fields, labels, defaults) with layout.save. Categories with category.add or category.hide; a new custom category also needs the reviewed schema change the command returns. A new field: a reviewed schema change, then an app revision that lists it in tableMap extraFields (and writableExtra). Code changes use begin_app_update and keep the v2 marker, role keys, the runway.month_closes runway.v2 contract, the calculation rules, frozen fields and appCommands.
9. Integrations. Programs milestones, CRO Selection awards, Contracts payment obligations and Fundraise tranches are Runway's own entries until the user chooses Use its data inside the app (a platform dialog). Linked data is read only here. Add to plan (source.add_to_plan) copies amounts into plan lines; source.update_line applies a changed source.
10. Automations. Four recommendations: runway alert email, month-close reminder, monthly exchange rates (research that saves only new runway.fx_rates rows under the bounded write permission approved with it) and the monthly runway digest email built from the frozen snapshot. Zero automations is supported.
11. Never compute or overwrite results, never treat contingent cash as committed, never give accounting, tax or investment advice, and confirm with the user before saving figures they did not state.

quickStart: Read the current guide and this template's documentation; pin life.cash-runway 3.0.0 and its digest with one requestKey.

Before installing, check for an archived Runway app and offer to restore it. The installation popup connects existing programs, organizations and agreements tables and offers the recommended automations.

Overview → Set up runway (or settings.save): reporting currency, opening bank balance and its month-end date, runway target (default 18 months); owners refine trailing window, reserve, loaded cost and categories in Settings.

Programs and Exchange rates screens: add programs, and a monthly rate (units per 1 EUR) for every currency other than the reporting currency, including the reporting currency itself when it is not EUR.
Plan → add spend and cash-in lines, payment schedules and milestones; From other sources adds CRO commitments, contract payments and expected financing. People → add current roles and planned hires.
Overview shows the runway, what needs attention, the cash curve and burn. Each month: Monthly close → Close <month>. Plan → Budgets → Lock as budget once per year to get variance.
Assistants: list_app_commands, then run_app_command; read commands return Runway's own figures and write commands save directly with the same checks as a click.
documentation.dataContract:
Stable role keys: runway.settings (one row: reporting_currency select of 12 currencies; enabled_currencies text comma list; runway_target_months number, default 18; trailing_window_months number 3 or 6; min_cash_reserve money; loaded_cost_pct number; opening_balance money in the reporting currency; opening_date date, the month-end of the opening balance; categories text comma list ordering the spend categories). runway.plan_lines ( name text*, direction select spend/cash_in*, category select Clinical/CMC/Research/People/G&A/Facilities/Other*, program_id text record ID, counterparty_id text record ID, agreement_id text record ID, schedule_group text, driver select monthly/one_off/spread*, amount money* non-negative, currency select*, start_month date*, end_month date (inclusive), status select committed/discretionary/contingent/received*, cash_in_type select equity/grant/partnership/tax_credit/other (required for cash_in), notes text, source_role text, source_record_id text, source_version text (set by Add to plan), archived boolean). runway.positions (title*, program_id, start_month*, end_month, annual_salary money*, currency*, status current/planned*, person_id text, archived). runway.actuals (month*, category*, program_id, direction*, amount*, currency*, cash_in_type, note). runway.month_closes, an app output for other apps (month*, closing_balance money*, currency*, closed boolean, commentary text, runway_months number, cash_out_month date, runway_status select ok/below_target, metrics text frozen JSON, rates_used text frozen JSON, closed_at date). runway.budgets (name*, year number*, locked_on date*, currency*, totals text frozen JSON, rates_used text frozen JSON, notes). runway.scenarios (name*, status draft/saved/adopted/archived*, changes_json text (the scenario's changes, written by the app), based_on_close date, based_on_version text forecast fingerprint (saved scenarios only), created_on date, summary text). runway.fx_rates (month*, currency*, rate_per_eur number*, source ecb/manual*, source_ref text). Core contract v1 (shared workspace tables, one per role): programs (name*, code, indication, modality, stage*, lead, status, archived; health fields are owned by the Programs app), organizations (name*, org_type, country, website, archived), agreements (name*, counterparty_id, agreement_type, status, effective_date, expiry_date, archived). Integrations (Runway's own table until the user links the provider inside the app; then read only): programs.plan_items programs.v2 (Runway's milestone list: name*, program_id, item_type, end_date* target month, status, is_key, archived; or the Programs app's key milestones), croselection.awards croselection.v1 (organization_id, service_type*, program_id, total, currency*, start_date, duration_months, decided_on*, agreement_id), contracts.obligations contracts.v1 (title*, agreement_id, kind*, direction*, due_date, recurrence, amount, currency, status*, verified, archived; only open payment obligations are offered, and only verified ones when linked), fundraise.tranches fundraise.v1 (tranche_no*, amount*, currency*, condition*, expected_on, status*). * = required. All fields are scalar (multiple:false); months are stored as the first day of the month; relationships are record IDs, never names.

Calculations (deterministic, in the app, no clock): the as-of month is the latest closed month, or the opening month. Cash starts from the opening balance, then each confirmed close. monthly = amount every month from start to end; one_off = amount in the start month; spread = amount ÷ months from start to end inclusive. People cost = annual_salary ÷ 12 × (1 + loaded_cost_pct/100) for active months. Amounts convert through EUR cross-rates: closed months use their own month's rate, future months the latest available rate; a missing rate flags and excludes the row. Net burn = spend − operating cash in (cash_in_type other); equity, grants, partnership and tax credits are financing. Runway = full months after the as-of month with forecast closing cash ≥ 0, counting committed and received cash in; a second value adds contingent. Cash-out month = first month below zero. Start-raise = first month with less than the target runway left. Cushion = months of cash after a milestone (to the reserve when one is set). Variance = actual − budget by month and category (and program where coded). The runway bridge splits the change since the last snapshot into closed months, spend lines, people and cash-in; the parts add up to the total.

Access: app-level access with app roles; Settings (business choices) are for owners of the app, record edits for editors, viewers read. Restrict positions.annual_salary with a database column restriction for anyone who should not see pay: live people cost and live runway then show restricted, and snapshots still show the approved runway. Missing partners: without programs, program breakdowns hide with a note and totals are unaffected; without programs.plan_items, only Runway milestones are used; references to archived, deleted or unreadable records show as unavailable and are kept on edit. Each screen reads only its tables (records.readMany): the forecast reads every row of its tables, up to 800 per table; exchange rates, programs and organizations read one sorted, searchable page; counts over a whole table use records.summarize. Partial, unavailable or unbound tables withhold exact totals, and data still loading shows as loading, never as zero. Categories: settings.categories lists the shown categories in order; names beyond Clinical, CMC, Research, People, G&A, Facilities and Other are custom (the select option is added by a reviewed schema change); People and Other always exist; hidden categories still count.
documentation.interactionContract: v2 app on the kit, with its own side navigation below the platform header and no header, banner or footer of its own; messages are the platform notice. Screens: overview, cash_flow, plan, people, scenarios, actuals (Monthly close), rates (Exchange rates), programs, organizations and settings (owners only). The layout declaration (templateLayoutSchema) keeps the 2.x screen ids overview, cash_flow, plan, people, scenarios, actuals and settings, so saved layout profiles stay valid; rates, programs and organizations follow them. Overview: runway sentence, runway, cash-out, start-raise, cash now, with contingent and trailing runway; Needs attention lists missing or excluded data with the action that fixes it (set up, starting point, add rates, close a month); cash curve and burn charts with a table of values; why runway changed since the last snapshot; cash at milestones with cushions. Cash flow: monthly table (opening, cash in, spend by category or category × program, net burn, closing), source (live forecast, what-if, saved scenarios, locked budgets), include contingent, drill-down to the lines behind a value, CSV as copyable text. Plan: lines with search and filters, a program picker remembered per person (output.context), inline edits of name, category, driver, amount, months and status, Edit, Duplicate, Delete (archive with Undo), payment schedule panel, From other sources with Add to plan and Update line; Milestones (own list or Programs key milestones, read only); Budgets (Lock as budget, locked budgets). People: list with inline edits, or a board where a planned hire is dragged to current (or moved with the card menu); headcount and people cost by program for 12 months; the side panel shows the runway effect before saving. Scenarios: build a what-if with any of 15 change kinds (nothing stored), save, open drafts, copy, adopt (one click; versions captured; stale records are rejected), archive, compare 2–4 with an overlay chart. Monthly close: starting point (opening balance and date, inline), months with status and record counts, Close <month> panel (bank balance, actuals by category, cash received, commentary), variance against the locked budget, snapshots, actual records (inline edits in open months; closed months are frozen). Exchange rates, Programs and Organizations: paged, sorted, searchable lists with inline edits and Add. Settings: the owner-only form, with links to platform Access and Automations. Every empty screen offers its first action. App commands (37) run the same functions as these controls.
documentation.lifecycle: Opening never writes. After the app is saved, every create, edit, delete, close, lock, scenario save and adoption from a person's click, change or submit saves at once with records.save (at most 50 changes), with the platform's checks; the screen then shows the saved data and the person's last action can be undone (Undo, 60 minutes, while the records are unchanged). Edits and deletes carry the record version captured when editing started, so a concurrent change of the same value is refused and the earlier value comes back with a message. Delete is an archive: nothing is removed. Closing a month writes the actuals and one month_closes record whose metrics JSON is frozen; budgets are frozen at lock; neither is edited later (only close commentary can change). What-ifs live only in the person's screen state until saved. A saved scenario is flagged Outdated when lines, positions, milestones, settings, closes or rates change after it was saved, and must be re-saved before adoption; drafts (left by an assistant) are never Outdated and cannot be adopted until saved. Lines added from another source keep its record ID and version; a later source change is flagged and applied only by Update line. Write commands from an assistant with Data = Edit save directly in one call, with the same checks; layout.save returns a change for a person to approve. Revisions keep the same app ID, bindings and access. An owner can upgrade a 2.2.0 or 2.2.1 copy to 3.0.0 (same tables, options and automations). Removing the app archives it and keeps every table and record.
limitations: No accounting, bank or payroll connectors and no file parsers; actuals are typed in or saved by an assistant from a document the user shares.
Monthly granularity only; no 13-week cash view, revenue, AR/AP, debt, deferred revenue or three-statement model.
Protect salaries with the database column restriction (platform Access); live people cost and live runway then show restricted and snapshots still show the approved runway.
Export CSV shows copyable CSV text; apps cannot start a file download. Database tables also offer CSV download in TrialAgents.

A custom category needs a reviewed schema change that adds its select option on plan lines and actuals; category.add returns it. Adoption is limited to 50 record changes; exchange-rate shifts are never adopted.
The exchange-rate automation needs a connected Claude or ChatGPT runner and write access for that assistant to the rates table; otherwise it shows Needs setup.
Layout declarations allow at most eight screens, so Exchange rates, Programs and Organizations cannot be reordered or hidden with layout.save.

examples.prompt: Set up Runway for our 20-person biotech: €8.4M in the bank at 31 Oct 2026, programs TX-1 and TX-2, Phase 1 readout in Sep 2027, a $4M grant we expect in mid-2027.
examples.expectedBehavior: Pins the template and installs it after the person confirms, then confirms the figures and saves them with commands: settings.save (EUR, opening 8,400,000 on 2026-10-31), two program.save, the main line.save spend lines, position.save, milestone.save, a contingent grant cash-in line in USD (cash_in_type grant) and monthly USD rates with fx.save. Explains that the grant is excluded from base runway until committed and reports summary.read. Nothing is seeded.

examples.prompt: Here's our October P&L. Close the month.
examples.expectedBehavior: Maps P&L lines to Runway categories and programs, asks about ambiguous lines and the closing bank balance, confirms the figures, then runs month.close. The app writes the actuals and the frozen snapshot and returns the runway; the assistant never computes or writes runway results itself.

examples.prompt: What if the Series A closes four months later and we pause program B?
examples.expectedBehavior: Runs scenario.evaluate with move_cash_in on the Series A line by +4 months and stop_program for program B from 2027-01, and reports Runway's own result before and after. Saves it (scenario.save) only when asked; adopts only on an explicit request.

examples.prompt: Add a Regulatory category and hide G&A; move the notes field to the top of the line form.
examples.expectedBehavior: For an owner of the app: category.add (saves the settings and returns the schema change to prepare with prepare_change), category.hide, and layout.save with order line_form [notes, …], which the person approves. For others, explains that Settings belong to the app's owners.
Saves the app with no automation; rates are entered on the Exchange rates screen or saved by the assistant on request. The app works fully without any automation.

tasks.whenUseful: Recommended at install (all selected; zero automations is fully supported): (1) runway alert email when a month close sets runway_status to below_target; (2) month-close reminder email on the 5th business day; (3) monthly exchange rates, research on the shared Claude or ChatGPT runner on the 3rd business day, Europe/Berlin, saving only new runway.fx_rates rows; (4) monthly runway digest email when a month is closed, built from the frozen snapshot.
tasks.readRequirements: Alert and digest: month_closes.month, closing_balance, currency, runway_months, cash_out_month, runway_status, commentary (read). Rates: settings.enabled_currencies and reporting_currency, existing fx_rates month/currency (read) for deduplication.
tasks.outputContract: Alert, reminder and digest: emails to the approved recipients only, with fixed text and the closed month's frozen figures; no independent schedule for the alert and digest. Rates: for each enabled currency other than EUR without a row for the previous month, one new fx_rates record {month: first day of previous month, currency, rate_per_eur: monthly average of ECB euro reference rates (four decimals), source: ecb, source_ref: ECB page URL}, saved under the bounded create-only permission approved with the automation (no updates, no other table); no_update when all rows exist; blocked when ECB data is unavailable, with nothing written.
tasks.promptExample: Monthly on the 3rd business day (Europe/Berlin): read Runway settings.enabled_currencies and existing fx_rates. For each enabled currency other than EUR with no row for the previous calendar month, compute the monthly average of the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates for that month (units per 1 EUR, four decimals) and save one fx_rates record with source ecb and the ECB page as source_ref. Never change existing rows. If every row already exists, report no_update. If ECB data is unavailable, report blocked and write nothing.

recommendedAutomations.name: Runway alert
recommendedAutomations.description: Email when a month close puts runway below the target.

email.subject: Runway is below target
email.text: The latest Runway close is below the runway target. Open Runway → Actuals → Snapshots for runway months, cash-out month and the start-raise date.

recommendedAutomations.name: Month-close reminder
recommendedAutomations.description: Monthly reminder to close last month in Runway.

email.subject: Close last month in Runway
email.text: It is time to close last month in Runway. Open Runway → Actuals → Close month, enter the bank balance and actuals by category, and add one commentary. If the month is already closed, ignore this email.

recommendedAutomations.name: Monthly exchange rates
recommendedAutomations.description: Adds last month's ECB average rates for the enabled currencies.

research.objective: Add last month's ECB euro reference rate averages to Runway's exchange-rate table for every enabled currency that does not have one yet.
research.instructions: Read Runway settings (enabled_currencies, reporting_currency) and the existing fx_rates rows (month, currency). The month is the previous calendar month. For each enabled currency other than EUR that has no fx_rates row for that month, compute the average of the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates published for that month, as units of the currency per 1 EUR rounded to four decimals, and save one new fx_rates record: month = first day of that month, currency, rate_per_eur, source = ecb, source_ref = the ECB page used. Deduplicate by month + currency; never change or remove existing rows and never write any other table. If every row already exists, finish with no_update. If ECB data for the month is unavailable or incomplete, finish blocked and write nothing.
research.sourcePolicy: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (ecb.europa.eu) only. No other source, estimate or interpolation.

recommendedAutomations.name: Monthly runway digest
recommendedAutomations.description: Email the closed month's frozen runway figures.

email.subject: Runway: month closed
email.text: A month was closed in Runway. These figures come from its frozen snapshot. Open Runway → Actuals → Snapshots for the burn, variance and runway bridge.
